title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
content_snippet: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus has spent the last few days getting review-bombed on Steam after it was discovered that a particular segment of the game used AI music. Reddit user ShweetsStuff discovered the songs used during a Grand Theft Auto-themed section. They found several audio files with Suno metadata that pointed back to […]
title_zh: 以撒的结合开发者因差评移除游戏AI音乐内容
summary_zh: 《以撒的结合：忏悔加强版》因部分音轨被玩家发现使用AI生成音乐，在Steam上遭遇差评轰炸。开发者随后将相关内容移除。
key_points: 游戏部分音轨被发现使用AI音乐，引发玩家不满
游戏在Steam平台遭到差评轰炸
开发者已移除引发争议的AI音乐内容

title: OpenAI’s chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development
content_snippet: To establish a speed limit on AI development, you need to agree on how to measure speed.
title_zh: OpenAI 首席科学家对限制 AI 发展提出思考
summary_zh: OpenAI 首席科学家认为，要对 AI 发展设置速度限制，首先需要就如何衡量发展速度达成共识。文章探讨了建立 AI 发展安全护栏的关键前提与衡量标准问题。
key_points: OpenAI 首席科学家探讨如何为 AI 发展设立速度限制
强调确立 AI 发展速度的统一衡量标准是必要前提
观点涉及 AI 安全治理与行业规范的确立
